results.title: Enhancing Access to and Sharing of Data
results.content: It requires clear provision of information to individuals about what personal data are being collected and used, and for what purpose – as specified in the data protection and privacy laws of most countries and in the OECD *Recommendation of the Council concerning Guidelines Governing the Protection of Privacy and Transborder Flows of Personal Data* (hereafter the “OECD Privacy Guidelines”) [(OECD, 2013[18])](/en/publications/enhancing-access-to-and-sharing-of-data_276aaca8-en/full-report/risks-and-challenges-of-data-access-and-sharing_5274577c.html#a4zOEC80). The share of organisations with effective risk management approaches to security still remains much too low, although there are significant variations across countries and by firm size.15 A number of obstacles preventing the effective use of risk management for addressing trust issues have been identified, the biggest one being insufficient budget and a lack of qualified personnel [(OECD, 2017[3])](/en/publications/enhancing-access-to-and-sharing-of-data_276aaca8-en/full-report/risks-and-challenges-of-data-access-and-sharing_5274577c.html#a4zOEC171b) as further discussed in the subsection “Capacity building: Fostering data-related infrastructures and skills” below. The OECD [(2013[18])](/en/publications/enhancing-access-to-and-sharing-of-data_276aaca8-en/full-report/risks-and-challenges-of-data-access-and-sharing_5274577c.html#a4zOEC80) *Guidelines on the Protection of Privacy and Transborder Flows of Personal Data* (paragraph 15(c)) call for controllers to provide notifications in cases where there has been a significant security breach affecting personal data.

results.title: The scope of the EU Data Act: what's in, what's out?
results.content: I. Connected products Under the Data Act, a “**connected product**” is defined in Article 2(5) as *any item that obtains, generates or collects data about its use or environment and can communicate that data via an electronic communications service, physical connection or on-device access, provided that its primary function is not simply to store, process or transmit data on behalf of another party.*  In practice, this is a very broad definition. Information that is not generated by use (for example, a device’s instruction manual, an ingredient list, or static technical specifications) is not covered by the Act. Such non-usage data (like a PDF manual or a fixed product description) does not need to be shared under this law.
